title: helianthemum marifolium f. vineale
intro: Helianthemum marifolium f. vineale, commonly known as Rockrose, is a plant species within the Cistaceae family. It is a type of flowering plant that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its medicinal properties. Rockrose has been used to treat various health issues, including anxiety and depression, due to its sedative and anxiolytic effects, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as promoting relaxation and reducing stress. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
